text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ugh... So this is... the dawn of a good omen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Fufu... When the reading came up as great misfortune no matter how many times I divined it, even my hand holding the crystal ball trembled a little...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Finally, this morning!
I pulled "A Tiny Bit of Small Fortune"...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A blissful morning, earned at the cost of my sleep over the past few days... Ah, how radiant...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Besides... I feel kind of...
all warm and fluffy, like in a dream... *yawn*...

Matikanefukukitaru continued to look sleepy
even after that...
